description_en: Detects deepfake risks in facial images
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl deepfake-detect-intl --product-code FACE_DEEPFAKE --scene-code 1234567890 --merchant-biz-id e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c000000 --face-input-type IMAGE --face-url https://cn-shanghai-aliyun-cloudauth-xxxxxx.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/verify/xxxxx/xxxxx.jpeg --face-base64 /9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeepfakeDetectIntl

parameters.help_en: The product solution to use. Set the value to FACE_DEEPFAKE
parameters.help_zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值：FACE_DEEPFAKE
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The custom scene ID for authentication. You can use this scene ID to query related records in the console. The value can be up to 10 characters long and can contain letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录使用。支持长度为10位的字母、数字或下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is a 32-character combination of letters and digits. The first few characters are a custom merchant abbreviation, the middle part can contain a timestamp, and the last part can be a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh: 商户请求的唯一标识，值为32位长度的字母数字组合。其中前几位字符由商户自定义的简称组成，中间部分可以包含一段时间，而后段可以采用随机或递增序列
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: Set the value to IMAGE to specify a facial image
parameters.name: face_input_type

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the facial image.
Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64
parameters.help_zh:
传入人脸图片URL地址。
FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个
parameters.name: face_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded content of the facial image.
Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64
parameters.help_zh:
传入人脸图片的Base64格式编码。
FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个
parameters.name: face_base64
